subject.name: Jeffrey Epstein
subject.publicSummary: Financier and convicted sex offender who died in federal custody in 2019 while facing new federal sex-trafficking charges.

powerRoles.title: Financier
powerRoles.sourceLabel: DOJ Office of Information Policy court-summary page identifying Epstein as a financier

records.title: Florida sex-offense conviction and sex-offender status
records.summary: Justice Department materials identify Epstein as a convicted sex offender and describe the 2006–2008 federal investigation as having been resolved through a non-prosecution agreement and a Florida state plea.
records.sourceLabel: DOJ release identifying Epstein as a convicted sex offender
records.outcome: State plea and conviction; sex-offender status followed.
records.rightOfReply: The conviction record is adjudicated; no contrary final disposition was located in the reviewed official sources.
records.counterEvidence: The DOJ OPR statement criticizes the federal resolution and victim treatment but does not vacate the state conviction.
records.proofNeeded: A competent court order vacating or reversing the state conviction would change this classification.
records.boundary: This entry is limited to the adjudicated Florida conviction and does not convert association with Epstein into wrongdoing.

records.title: 2019 federal sex-trafficking indictment
records.summary: Federal prosecutors charged Epstein with sex trafficking of minors and conspiracy, alleging conduct in New York and Florida involving dozens of underage girls.
records.sourceLabel: U.S. Attorney's Office, Southern District of New York — 2019 charging release
records.jurisdiction: Southern District of New York, United States
records.status: closed without adjudication after defendant's death
records.outcome: No trial verdict was reached on these counts; the prosecution ended after Epstein died in custody.
records.rightOfReply: The charging release expressly states that the indictment contained allegations and that the presumption of innocence applied.
records.counterEvidence: Because Epstein died before trial, the 2019 federal allegations were never adjudicated.
records.proofNeeded: A trial verdict was impossible after the defendant's death; the indictment remains an official allegation, not a conviction.
records.boundary: This entry reports the federal charges only. It does not present the untried counts as proven facts.
